items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: 825 Mio. Aktien zu 70–78 USD plus Privatplatzierung über 26 Mrd. USD; Preisfestsetzung am Mittwochabend, 18.11., Handelsstart am Donnerstag, 19.11. Laut Bloomberg (via The Next Web, 16.11.) fast siebenfach überzeichnet, Orderbuch soll am 17.11. schließen – unbestätigt.
note.bg: 825 млн. акции по 70–78 USD плюс частно пласиране за 26 млрд. USD; цената се определя вечерта в сряда, 18.11., а търговията започва в четвъртък, 19.11. Според Bloomberg (чрез The Next Web, 16.11.) поръчките са почти седем пъти повече, а книгата се затваря на 17.11. – непотвърдено.
note.en: 825m shares at USD 70–78 plus a USD 26bn private placement; pricing due on Wednesday evening, 18 Nov, trading on Thursday, 19 Nov. Bloomberg (via The Next Web, 16 Nov) says the book is almost seven times covered and closes on 17 Nov – unconfirmed.
note.es: 825 millones de acciones a 70–78 USD más una colocación privada de 26.000 millones de USD; precio el miércoles 18/11 por la noche, cotización desde el jueves 19/11. Según Bloomberg (vía The Next Web, 16/11), la demanda es casi siete veces la oferta y el libro cierra el 17/11 – sin confirmar.
note.tr: 70–78 USD'den 825 milyon hisse ve 26 milyar USD'lik özel yerleşim; fiyat 18.11 Çarşamba akşamı belirlenecek, işlemler 19.11 Perşembe başlayacak. Bloomberg'e göre (The Next Web aracılığıyla, 16.11) talep arzın yaklaşık yedi katı, talep defteri 17.11'de kapanıyor – doğrulanmadı.

items.name: Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL)

note.de: Coal India verkauft 10 % der Tochter (661,8 Mio. Altaktien) zu 129–136 Rupien, rund 89,8 Mrd. Rupien; Zeichnung 19.–23.11., Notierung voraussichtlich am 27.11.
note.bg: Coal India продава 10% от дъщерното дружество (661,8 млн. съществуващи акции) по 129–136 рупии, около 89,8 млрд. рупии; записване 19–23.11., листване се очаква на 27.11.
note.en: Coal India sells 10% of the unit (661.8m existing shares) at INR 129–136, about INR 89.8bn; subscription 19–23 Nov, listing expected on 27 Nov.
note.es: Coal India vende el 10 % de la filial (661,8 millones de acciones existentes) a 129–136 rupias, unos 89.800 millones de rupias; suscripción del 19 al 23/11, cotización prevista el 27/11.
note.tr: Coal India iştirakinin %10'unu (661,8 milyon mevcut hisse) 129–136 rupiden satıyor, yaklaşık 89,8 milyar rupi; talep toplama 19–23.11, işlem başlangıcı 27.11'de bekleniyor.

items.name: Japan Home Shield (667A)

sector.bg: Геотехнически проучвания и проверка на сгради
sector.es: Estudios geotécnicos e inspección de edificios

note.de: Börsenzulassung erteilt; reiner Verkauf von 4,17 Mio. Altaktien (plus Mehrzuteilung) zu vorläufig 1.220–1.240 JPY; Zeichnungsfrist bis 17.11., Festlegung des Ausgabepreises am 18.11., Konsortialführer Nomura.
note.bg: Листването е одобрено; продават се само 4,17 млн. съществуващи акции (плюс допълнително разпределение) при ориентировъчна цена 1220–1240 JPY; записване до 17.11., определяне на цената на 18.11., водеща банка Nomura.
note.en: Listing approved; secondary sale only of 4.17m existing shares (plus over-allotment) at an indicative JPY 1,220–1,240; book-building until 17 Nov, offer price due on 18 Nov, lead manager Nomura.
note.es: Cotización aprobada; solo venta de 4,17 millones de acciones existentes (más sobreasignación) a 1.220–1.240 JPY indicativos; colocación hasta el 17/11, precio el 18/11, coordinador Nomura.
note.tr: Kotasyon onaylandı; yalnızca 4,17 milyon mevcut hissenin satışı (artı ek tahsis), gösterge fiyat 1.220–1.240 JPY; talep toplama 17.11'e kadar, fiyat 18.11'de belirlenecek, lider aracı Nomura.

items.src_n: Japan Home Shield – Mitteilung zur Börsenzulassung an der TSE Standard (26.10.2026); IPO Getter – Japan Home Shield (667A), aktualisiert 12.11.2026

items.name: METKA (Metlen)

note.de: Neue Aktien über rund 250 Mio. Euro plus Verkauf von Altaktien durch Metlen; laut Dnews (16.11.) sollen 25–30 % des Kapitals für rund 350 Mio. Euro angeboten werden, Bewertung rund 1 Mrd. Euro, Prospektprüfung diese Woche; Preisspanne offen.
note.bg: Нови акции за около 250 млн. евро плюс продажба на съществуващи от Metlen; според Dnews (16.11.) ще се предложат 25–30% от капитала за около 350 млн. евро при оценка около 1 млрд. евро, проспектът се разглежда тази седмица; ценовият диапазон не е обявен.
note.en: New shares worth about EUR 250m plus a sale of existing shares by Metlen; Dnews (16 Nov) says 25–30% of the equity is to be offered for about EUR 350m at a valuation of about EUR 1bn, with the prospectus reviewed this week; price range not yet set.
note.es: Acciones nuevas por unos 250 millones de euros más venta de acciones existentes por Metlen; según Dnews (16/11) se ofrecerá el 25–30 % del capital por unos 350 millones, con una valoración de 1.000 millones y revisión del folleto esta semana; sin rango de precios.
note.tr: Yaklaşık 250 milyon euroluk yeni hisse ve Metlen'in mevcut hisse satışı; Dnews'e göre (16.11) sermayenin %25–30'u yaklaşık 350 milyon euroya, yaklaşık 1 milyar euro değerlemeyle sunulacak, izahname bu hafta inceleniyor; fiyat aralığı henüz belli değil.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – American Barrick Gold files for an estimated $6 billion IPO (10.11.2026); The Deep Dive (11.11.2026: Start bis Anfang 2027 laut CEO Mark Hill)

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 17 USD, die Mitte der Spanne von 16–18 USD; laut Renaissance Capital schloss die Aktie den ersten Handelstag 67,6 % über dem Ausgabepreis.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 17 USD – средата на диапазона 16–18 USD; според Renaissance Capital акцията завърши първия ден с 67,6% над цената на предлагането.
note.en: Priced at USD 17, the midpoint of the USD 16–18 range; according to Renaissance Capital the stock ended its first day 67.6% above the offer price.
note.es: Precio de salida de 17 USD, el punto medio del rango de 16–18 USD; según Renaissance Capital, cerró su primer día un 67,6 % por encima del precio de salida.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 16–18 USD aralığının ortası olan 17 USD; Renaissance Capital'e göre hisse ilk günü halka arz fiyatının %67,6 üzerinde kapattı.
